answer_2.quote: The quality of generated textual summary is evaluated by standard full-length Rouge F1 following previous works. R-1, R-2, and R-L refer to unigram, bigrams, and the longest common subsequence respectively. The quality of chosen cover frame is evaluated by mean average precision (MAP) and recall at position (R n @k).

answer_4.quote: In addition to automatic evaluation, system performance was also evaluated on the generated textual summary by human judgments on 70 randomly selected cases similar to ... Participants evaluated summaries produced by Unified, How2, MOF and our DIMS ... Our second evaluation estimated the overall quality of the textual summaries by asking participants to rank them according to its Informativeness, Coherence, and Succinctness.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked to rank summaries based on predefined criteria and answer questions derived from gold summaries in a QA paradigm.
